speaker: Doctor
text:
The lab results confirm significant liver injury with markedly elevated transaminases and bilirubin. Given your history of stimulant use and the pattern of enzyme elevation, have you been taking any over-the-counter pain relievers, specifically acetaminophen (paracetamol)?

speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury secondary to stimulant use. The combination of markedly elevated transaminases (AST/ALT >600 IU/L), hyperbilirubinemia, coagulopathy (INR 1.5), and a history of stimulant use, despite a negative serum acetaminophen level, is consistent with severe hepatotoxicity from acute ingestion where the drug may have been metabolized or missed by sampling. Immediate N-acetylcysteine therapy is indicated.
